fullDraft:
In the six months to March 2026, Patria Private Equity Trust (PPET) delivered a NAV total return of 3.1% and a share price total return of 5.5%, despite volatile markets driven by Middle East tensions, higher energy prices, and weaker public software valuations. NAV per share rose to 862.5 pence, supported by portfolio revenue and earnings growth, with the underlying portfolio generating a 2.7% local-currency return.

PPET committed to ten new investments and commitments across primary funds, a secondary, new direct investments, a Patria-managed co-investment fund, and a follow-on. Realizations and drawdowns reflected continued but slower M&A activity, while outstanding commitments, overcommitment, liquidity, and net gearing all remained within the manager's stated parameters.

Read more here: www.sample-link.com
